data.title: 日奈 · 黑礼服的钢琴排练
data.description: 【日奈 · 黑礼服的钢琴排练】演出前的音乐厅还没有观众，日奈穿着带褶边的黑色晚礼服和长手套，珍珠项链在琴灯下泛着柔光。她端坐在钢琴前，双手落在琴键上，反复练习同一小段旋律——「这里再来一次。正式演出之前，想把每个音都弹稳。」
data.action: 端坐钢琴凳上，双手弹奏琴键，视线专注于琴谱
data.promptProse: Hina rehearses the same short phrase at the grand piano before the empty music hall fills, wearing her black ruffled evening gown, long gloves and pearl necklace. The side-on medium view keeps the score and both hands on the keys visible, with empty seating behind. The piano lamp warms her fingers and pearl surfaces, while a soft stage spotlight separates the gown's folded hem from the darker instrument.
data.camera: medium shot from the piano side, score and both hands on keys visible
